reports.text: Core biopsy: invasive ductal carcinoma, grade 2. ER positive, PR positive, HER2 negative. Margins not assessed on core sample.
Mammogram/US: 1.8 cm irregular mass in left upper outer quadrant corresponding to biopsy site. No definite axillary adenopathy.

patientContext.presenting: Newly diagnosed left breast mass after screening

specialistQuestions: What staging workup should be discussed before treatment planning?

recommendedNextSteps: Discuss staging and multidisciplinary oncology review
Discuss surgical and systemic therapy options with oncology
expectedQuestions: Is axillary staging and receptor-directed therapy plan complete?
